title: AI credit lending is an ‘unambiguous good’: Upstart CEO explains
summary: Fintech company Upstart (UPST) reported strong quarterly revenue but missed analysts’ earnings estimates. Upstart co-founder and CEO Paul Gu sits down with Yahoo Finance’s Josh Lipton to discuss the results, the company’s trajectory, and why finance and lending are great places to apply artificial intelligence (AI).
